objective: Estimate current matched-item precision for each of IGRM's five channels under an external, blinded application of the frozen rubric; separately describe article-instance and normalized-story precision.
scope_limit: This audit does not estimate population recall, event detection, risk accuracy, historical precision before the sampled source days, or causal validity.

sample.article_instance_stratum: 75 URLs per channel, sampled uniformly without replacement from the union of exact matched article URLs across the two pinned full-depth source days. URL is the unit; syndicated copies remain separate because IGRM counts articles.
sample.story_cluster_stratum: 25 normalized-headline clusters per channel, sampled uniformly without replacement after excluding every normalized title represented in that channel's article-instance draw. One deterministic representative URL per cluster.
sample.pilot_rule: Four unscored items per channel, disjoint from the scored sheet by URL and normalized headline. Coders may discuss only the pilot before beginning independent scored work.

blindness.meaning: Blind to system decisions and sampling stratum, not blind to the target channel or to the fact that this is an IGRM matched-item audit.
blindness.repository_access: External coders must not inspect the IGRM repository or website between opening the scored sheet and locking their completed copy.

labels.ON: Substantively about the named channel under auditor/RUBRIC.md.
labels.OFF: Not substantively about the named channel under auditor/RUBRIC.md.
labels.ABSTAIN: Insufficient accessible evidence for a defensible ruling; reported and excluded from the precision denominator.
labels.translation: No automated translation. Non-English items without accessible English evidence are ABSTAIN.

estimands.five_primary_estimates: For each coder and channel separately in the article-instance stratum: ON / (ON + OFF), with a Wilson 95% interval. ABSTAIN is excluded from the denominator and its count is always reported. With two coders, both coder-specific estimates publish separately; there is no consensus or adjudicated primary estimate.
estimands.secondary_story_estimates: The same quantity for each channel in the normalized-headline stratum, labelled descriptive story-level precision.
estimands.secondary_macro: Equal-channel mean of the five article-instance precision estimates. It is not an overall volume-weighted precision estimate.
estimands.hypothesis_tests: None. No p-values or multiple-testing-adjusted claims.

quality_gates.per_channel_precision_pass: Pass only if at least 60 of 75 article-instance rows receive firm labels and the Wilson 95% lower bound is at least 0.80.
quality_gates.per_channel_inconclusive: Fewer than 60 firm article-instance labels is inconclusive, never a pass.
quality_gates.inter_coder_evaluable_if_two_coders: Evaluable with at least 400 firm-overlap rows and a non-constant pooled firm-label set. Fewer overlaps is INCONCLUSIVE. An exactly all-ON or all-OFF overlap is reported as NOT IDENTIFIABLE FROM CONSTANT LABELS, not a pass or failure, even if raw agreement or AC1 is numerically high. No minimum OFF prevalence is imposed.
quality_gates.inter_coder_pass_if_evaluable: On all firm-overlap rows, raw agreement at least 0.90 and Gwet's AC1 at least 0.70. Cohen's kappa publishes descriptively with a prevalence caveat and is not gated.
quality_gates.one_coder_rule: With one coder, no inter-coder statistic or reliability claim is permitted.
quality_gates.publication: Every per-channel result, abstention count, interval, gate failure and disagreement publishes regardless of direction. Payment and publication are not conditional on passing.

coder_independence.minimum: No role in designing IGRM, its dictionaries, sample, rubric or machine auditor; disclose any relationship with the project or founder.
coder_independence.work_rule: After the pilot, coders work independently and do not discuss scored rows until both files are locked.
coder_independence.tool_rule: Coders may use a normal browser to inspect linked evidence but may not use an LLM, automated classifier, bulk-label tool or another person to decide or draft scored labels.
coder_independence.payment_rule: Fixed compensation agreed before labelling, never contingent on agreement or outcome. Recruitment source, coder count, qualifications and compensation band are disclosed with results.

analysis.inter_coder: With exactly two coders, report raw agreement and Gwet's AC1 on firm-label overlap, applying the frozen evaluability and pass rules. Publish Cohen's kappa descriptively with a prevalence caveat. Primary Wilson estimates remain separate for each coder; no consensus or adjudicated estimate exists in the primary.
analysis.missing_urls: Use accessible title/page evidence or ABSTAIN. Do not replace an unavailable sampled URL.
analysis.deviations: Any source substitution, sample replacement, rubric change after scored work begins, label recoding or adjudication is a deviation and must publish before the affected result.

attestation.limits: The project maintainer has seen some source-day headlines during ordinary operations. That does not alter the frozen random draw but means the maintainer is not an eligible external coder.
